overlay.title: Player overlay
overlay.subtitle: Pick a video of a match, or point the camera at one. Klupa finds the players in the picture, follows each of them and tells the two teams apart by their shirts, all on this device.

start.title: Start with a video or the camera
start.tips: It works best from high up and to the side, with a good part of the pitch in the picture.
start.privacy: Nothing is uploaded. The picture goes from your file or your camera to a model that runs in this browser. No frame, clip or number read from it leaves the device.
start.model: The first time, a 7 MB model is downloaded from this site and then kept on the device.
start.sample: Try it on a sample clip
start.sampleCredit: Sample clip: "Group of elderly men playing a game of soccer" by Pressmaster on Pexels, used under the Pexels licence and shortened to nine seconds.

find.title: Finds the people
find.body: A small open model, EfficientDet-Lite0, looks at each frame and marks every person it sees.

follow.title: Follows each one
follow.body: Boxes that overlap from one frame to the next are the same player, so each keeps one number while in view.

teams.title: Tells the teams apart
teams.body: The colour of each upper body is measured and the colours are split into two groups. Anyone far from both, such as a referee, is drawn white.

limits.title: What it cannot do
limits.position: Without calibrating the pitch it shows where players are in the picture, not where they are on the pitch. It measures no distance and no speed.
limits.small: Players who are small in the picture, such as those on the far side of a full-size pitch, are often missed. The closer and higher the camera, the more it finds.
limits.numbers: The numbers are given in the order players are found. They are not shirt numbers, and a player who leaves the picture comes back with a new one.
limits.crowd: Players standing behind one another can be merged or swapped. Substitutes, coaches and spectators in the picture are people too, and are counted.
limits.kits: Kits of a similar colour cannot be split. The screen then says so and draws everyone white instead of guessing. With only one team in the picture, a referee or a goalkeeper can be taken for the other team.
limits.tested: Checked in tests on generated cases, with a test camera and on the sample clip, not yet on a real match filmed from the touchline with a phone.

live.title: The picture with the overlay
live.hidden: The camera was switched off because this page was hidden.
live.privacy: Still nothing uploaded: the model, the picture and the drawing all stay in this browser. Only boxes and colours are remembered between frames, and Stop forgets them.

readout.title: In the picture now
readout.waiting: Nobody found yet. Players get a ring once they have been seen in three frames.
readout.cannotSplit: The shirt colours are too alike to tell the teams apart, so everyone is drawn white.

layers.title: Layers
layers.ringsDetail: A ring at each player's feet, in the colour of their team's shirts.
layers.numbersDetail: The number each player keeps while in the picture.
layers.trailsDetail: Where each player's feet were over the last few frames.

denied.title: Permission for the camera was refused
denied.body: Allow the camera for this site in the browser's settings and try again, or choose a video instead.

no-camera.title: No camera was found
no-camera.body: The browser finds no camera on this device. Choose a video instead.

in-use.title: The camera is busy
in-use.body: Another app or tab is using the camera. Close it and try again.

model.title: The model could not be loaded
model.body: Check the connection and try again.

video.title: This video could not be played
video.body: The browser cannot read this file. Try a clip filmed on a phone (MP4 or MOV).

unknown.title: The camera could not be started
unknown.body: Try again, or choose a video instead.

overlay.related: See a whole match from tracking data in the 3D replay
